sentences.text: Counsel for the objector submits that complainant has no objection if appellant is granted suspension of sentence.

After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration that the the source of age of the prosecutrix recorded in the scholar register has not been proved by the prosecution and same is recorded on the basis of guess, the said recording of the age of the prosecutrix cannot be the basis for conviction as already held by the Division Bench in the case of Tejubai Vs. State of MP,
2025(1) MPLJ Cr.75, further the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution story and appellant has undergone jail sentence of 5 years, we are of the considered opinion that the appellant is entitled for grant of suspension of jail sentence.
